packageRules.description: This repository publishes agentcfg and consumes it, so its release version and its pinned config_version are one number line. A bump pull request here merges as `chore(deps): ...`, which bump-version.yml reads and releases from — leaving the pin one patch behind again, forever. The pin therefore moves by hand, in the change that warrants it, which is step 8 of /new-value. Consumers are unaffected: this rule is local to this repository.
